cohort: 275 patients treated with atosiban for fetal prolonged deceleration and tachysystole at gestational age 37 0/7 to 43 0/7 weeks
finding: Atosiban administration for tachysystole during labor may increase vaginal delivery rates but also may be associated with a higher risk of postpartum hemorrhage.
mod_finding: Atosiban administration for fetal deceleration and tachysystole was associated with increased vaginal delivery rates, but potentially increased the risk of postpartum hemorrhage.
